en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional outlaw (hajduk-style) song with two versions. 'Престегнал магаренцето' is my reading (he girded/saddled the donkey); 'малихера' I read as the Mannlicher rifle; Resava is a place name I could not verify.

lines.cyr: Бог да го бие и да го убие
lines.lat: Bog da go bie i da go ubie
lines.en: May God strike him and kill him,
crazy Gono.

lines.cyr: Ајде ќе ми оди, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Ajde ḱe mi odi, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: Come on, he goes off, crazy Gono,
to Resava.

lines.cyr: Ајде ќе ми оди, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Ajde ḱe mi odi, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: Come on, he goes off, crazy Gono,
to Resava.

lines.cyr: Ајде го сретнаја, ем му викаја
lines.lat: Ajde go sretnaja, em mu vikaja
lines.en: Come on, they met him and called out to him,
the villagers:

lines.cyr: - Ајде не ми оди, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: - Ajde ne mi odi, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: - Come on, do not go, crazy Gono,
to Resava.

lines.cyr: Ајде ќе те сретне, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Ajde ḱe te sretne, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: Come on, he will meet you, crazy Gono,
Selil Pasha.

lines.cyr: Ајде не послушал луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Ajde ne poslušal ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: Come on, he did not listen, crazy Gono,
to the villagers,

lines.cyr: ајде ми престегнал, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: ajde mi prestegnal, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: come on, he girded on, crazy Gono,
the little donkey.

lines.cyr: Ајде ми го удри, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Ajde mi go udri, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: Come on, he struck him, crazy Gono,
Selil Pasha.

lines.cyr: Ајде бог да бие и да го убие
lines.lat: Ajde bog da bie i da go ubie
lines.en: Come on, may God strike and kill him,
crazy Gono.

lines.cyr: Ајде се преправил, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Ajde se prepravil, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: Come on, he disguised himself, crazy Gono,
as an old grandfather.

lines.cyr: Ајде стари дедо, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Ajde stari dedo, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: Come on, an old grandfather, crazy Gono,
from Mariovo.

lines.cyr: Ајде си наметнал, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Ajde si nametnal, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: Come on, he threw over himself, crazy Gono,
a little blanket.

lines.cyr: И под ќебенце, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: I pod ḱebence, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: And under the blanket, crazy Gono,
a Mannlicher rifle.

lines.cyr: И под ќебенце, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: I pod ḱebence, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: And under the blanket, crazy Gono,
a Mannlicher rifle.

lines.cyr: Ајде ќе ми оди, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Ajde ḱe mi odi, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: Come on, he goes off, crazy Gono,
to Resava.

lines.cyr: На пат го пречекал, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Na pat go prečekal, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: On the road he was met, crazy Gono,
by Selim Pasha.

lines.cyr: На пат го пречекал, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Na pat go prečekal, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: On the road he was met, crazy Gono,
by Selim Pasha.

lines.cyr: - Ајде каде одиш, стари бре дедо,
lines.lat: - Ajde kade odiš, stari bre dedo,
lines.en: - Come on, where are you going, old grandfather,
from Mariovo?

lines.cyr: Нели го виде, стари бре дедо,
lines.lat: Neli go vide, stari bre dedo,
lines.en: Did you not see, old grandfather,
crazy Gono?

lines.cyr: Нели го виде, стари бре дедо,
lines.lat: Neli go vide, stari bre dedo,
lines.en: Did you not see, old grandfather,
crazy Gono?

lines.cyr: - И да го видам, Селим бре Паша,
lines.lat: - I da go vidam, Selim bre Paša,
lines.en: - Even if I saw him, Selim Pasha,
crazy Gono,

lines.cyr: Јас луди Гоно, Селим бре Паша,
lines.lat: Jas ludi Gono, Selim bre Paša,
lines.en: I do not know crazy Gono, Selim Pasha,
I do not know him.

lines.cyr: Јас луди Гоно, Селим бре Паша,
lines.lat: Jas ludi Gono, Selim bre Paša,
lines.en: I do not know crazy Gono, Selim Pasha,
I do not know him.

lines.cyr: Одил што одил, луди бре Гоно,
lines.lat: Odil što odil, ludi bre Gono,
lines.en: He walked as he walked, crazy Gono,
and then turned back.
And he unhooked the Mannlicher rifle
from his shoulder.

lines.cyr: - Елај да го видиш, аго бре ефенди,
lines.lat: - Elaj da go vidiš, ago bre efendi,
lines.en: - Come here and see him, aga, effendi,
crazy Gono!
